text: A tournament is a set of games where many players compete. Bodhana played in a huge chess tournament.
To represent a place means to play or speak for it. Bodhana played for England.
To balance two things means to make time for both. Bodhana makes time for chess and for school.
Chess is a board game for two players. Each player moves pieces to trap the other player's king.
England is a country in the United Kingdom, in Europe. Bodhana is from England.
Uzbekistan is a country in Asia. The big chess tournament was held there.
Samarkand is a very old city in Uzbekistan. The chess games took place there.
International means between many countries. Players came from all over the world.
To make history means to do something that nobody has done before.
Woman grandmaster is a high chess title. Only females can earn this one.
A grandmaster is one of the best chess players in the world.
A title is a special name you earn, like grandmaster. It shows how good a player is.
FIDE is the group that runs chess around the world. It gives players their ratings.
A rating is a number that shows how strong a chess player is. Winning against strong players raises it.
A norm is a great result at a tournament. A player needs three norms to win the grandmaster title.
International master is a chess title. It is one step below grandmaster.
Females are girls and women.
Harrow is a town in London, England. Bodhana lives there.
London is the biggest city in England.
A chess wizard is someone who is amazing at chess. It is like magic.
Covid is an illness that spread around the world. For a while, many people stayed home.
During a lockdown, people must stay at home. Schools and shops can be closed.
Almost by accident means it happened by chance. She did not plan it.
Engineers are people who design and build things, like bridges or machines.
YouTube is a website where people watch videos.
This is a chess contest for kids from schools all over Europe.
This is a club in Harrow where people meet to play chess.
The Chess Olympiad is a big contest where teams from many countries play chess.
A champion is the winner. The Women's British Chess Champion is the best woman player in Britain.
To defeat someone means to beat them in a game.
Board one is the first table in a team match. The best player sits there.
To draw a game means it ends in a tie. Nobody wins and nobody loses.
Tied means both players have the same score. Nobody wins.
A strong showing means she did very well in the contest.
A booster seat is a cushion that lifts you up so you can reach a table.
Nervous means a little scared or worried before something big.
Proud means you feel very good about something you did.
A rank is a level. A higher rank means a better player.
